Author: raydenhui
Name: Sinophone
Punchline: Official Chinese dialogue for FFXIV, as you play.
Description: Shows the official Simplified or Traditional Chinese translation of FFXIV text: dialogue in an overlay or in the game's own windows, cutscene subtitles, battle talk, chat bubbles, selection dialogs, nameplates, and item tooltips. Data comes from the official CN/TC game files. Works with the English, Japanese, German, or French client.
